$comment: [[D-C-TAG-DEFINED-IN-A-PARAMETER-LIST-REFUSED]] runtime witness for the SECOND of the two exemptions to the one-scope rule (C 6.2.1p4 with C 6.4.2.2: `__func__` is declared at the top of every function body, in the scope the parameter list shares). A body may declare its own `__func__`. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-23: MSVC 19.51 (/std:clatest) BUILDS this file and RUNS it to 42 — the body's array is the one named — while gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 (-std=c2x and -std=c17) and MinGW gcc refuse it (both treat the name as reserved). One working reference makes it required.
$commentWhyNotVacuous: The predefined `__func__` of this function is "f" and the body's own is "g": an exit of 0 means the predefined one won, and a refusal means the exemption was lost.
